title: System administration
load_error: Could not load this information. Please retry.
forbidden_help: This account is not a platform administrator. Sign in with an authorized account or contact the operator.
unconfigured_help: The operator must set AURO_ADMIN_EMAILS to the administrator login emails and restart the API.
scope_help: Manage the MCP services Auro provides to external agents. Changes apply to every world.
policy_effect: Saving applies to the next MCP request, including existing clients. Created game sessions can continue.
conflict: Another administrator changed this policy. Discard your changes and review the latest version before saving.
save_error: Could not save. Your proposed policy is preserved; please retry.
empty_activity: No matching records yet. New MCP calls and policy changes will appear here.
privacy: Records contain call metadata only. Tokens, character drafts and tool results are not stored.
games_scope_help: Applies to existing and new worlds. World members cannot change these policies.
game_visibility_help: Hiding the sidebar entry keeps search and direct links available. Closing a game also restricts its APIs.
game_binding_help: Simulation data stays within its world. Worlds without an initialized simulation show an empty state. These settings do not start, stop or reset the simulation.
game_no_exceptions: All worlds inherit the global policy.
game_impact: After saving: {{available}} of {{total}} worlds available · {{visible}} sidebar entries
game_preview_error: Could not calculate the affected worlds. Edit the policy or refresh and try again.
game_effect_help: Existing data is preserved. API restrictions apply on the next request; other clients refresh entries within 30 seconds while active.
game_audit_help: Records who changed each policy and its previous and saved values.
game_policy_error: Could not verify game access. Please try again.
game_not_open: This game is not open in the current world.
